Cow Overview
Cow
is a
Beast Form
and a
Curse
bestowed by
Maronesa
in the
Crystal Cavern
or in the
Dark Chapel
.
Cows are able to collect
Grass
and
Milk
periodically. They can consume grass for a heal, which turns out to be a cheap, potent self-healing mechanism.
Being a cow means you look harmless to other animals, so deer and similar animals don’t run away from you.
If you get tired of being a cow, kill
Maronesa
to remove the curse. You can also use a
Minor Panacea
, though this is generally considered a very wasteful use of the item.
For more information on how to navigate being turned into an animal visit the
Beast Forms
page for advice.
In-Game Description
The art of living and fighting as a cow.
Training Cow
Being cursed by
Maronesa
will start a timer, turning you into a cow in 2 minutes
Suspicious Cow
will train Clobbering Hoof
Raul
will unlock levels 51-70 and train 51+ abilities
Noita the Green
unlocks 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Big Footed Jim
deep beneath
Povus
.

Cow Mechanics
Out-of-Combat Experience
Cows are kind of screwed with hooves instead of hands, meaning they can’t use a saw for
Carpentry
, for instance. But with a little imagination we can envision a cow planting vegetables and growing a garden, so they can do that, and a few other things.
Vegetarian Cows
Cows that maintain a vegetarian diet can be milked by other players more often, as follows: newbie or non-vegetarian cow: once per hour (unchanged); low-level vegetarian cow: once every 45 minutes; vegetarian cow over level 24: once every 30 minutes; vegetarian cow over level 49: once every 15 minutes - Two higher-level versions of the Collect Milk ability are given out at Cow level 38 and 52. They have faster reset times, allowing you to collect milk more quickly. These versions only work if you have the
Vegetarian badge
.
Riding
As a
Beast Form
, Cows are not able to use the traditional Horse mounts offered through
Riding
. Instead,
Raul
in
Animal Town
teaches mount-form to Cow players who are at least level 25, as well as a speed-up ability that consumes grass.
Equipment
Cow armor can be crafted through
Blacksmithing
(shoes) and
Toolcrafting
(champron and barding). The Champron (Head slot) gives extra resistance to Piercing and Slashing damage, while the Barding (Chest) gives resistance to just Piercing. Cow Shoes give you extra speed while sprinting.

Cows
should obtain the
Sigil Scripting
recipe
Cow Inscription,
which allows for the creation of
Cow Malachite
.
This attuned gemstone can be used in any recipe which calls for the use of
Crystals
to create equipment with
Cow

Trivia
Originally, there was a mysterious bucket at the end of the tutorial cave. Drinking from this would turn you into a cow, and the main way to become human was by completing a quest from
Harry the Wolf
. Global chat was filled with moooooo!
Later on, the bucket was replaced by
Maronesa
, still in the tutorial cave. The big warning message deterred some players, but it was still pretty common for newbies to emerge as cows.
Eventually Maronesa was moved to
Crystal Cavern
, and
Gajus the Big-Headed
took her spot.
